title: A Landfall for the Wreck
author: Oscar Sandoval
blurb: Vesper Joubert, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
